listenings.text: Hi, I'm Linnea, and I live in Stockholm. Many visitors ask me what they should do here. My first tip: take a boat. Stockholm is on fourteen islands, and the city looks beautiful from the water. In summer, go to the countryside and swim in a lake. The water is cold, but it's very clean. If you would like to see the northern lights, you need to go to the far north, in winter. It's a long trip, but it's worth it. And please, try a local dish. Everybody knows our meatballs, but my favorite is a cinnamon bun with a coffee in the afternoon. We call this break fika.

Hello, I'm Callum, and I'm a tour guide in Edinburgh. Every morning I start my tour at the castle. It's on a big rock, so the view of the city is fantastic. Most of my visitors want to see the castle first. In the afternoon, we walk down the old street to the palace. Twice a week, I also do a day trip to the Highlands. We leave at eight in the morning and come back at eight at night. We see the countryside, the mountains and Loch Ness. Everybody would like to see the monster. I don't think it's real, but I always tell people: maybe today!

reading.rtitle: Three Northern Trips for Your List
paras: Do you want to see Europe, but not the usual places? Try the north. First, the Netherlands. In Amsterdam, the best way to see the city is from the water or from a bike. There are more than one hundred kilometers of canals, and you can rent a bike almost everywhere. Would you like to leave the city? Take a day trip to the countryside and see the old windmills.

Second, Scotland. Edinburgh is a beautiful old city, and Edinburgh Castle sits on a big rock right in the center. From there, many visitors want to go north, to the Highlands. The countryside is green and wild, with mountains and lakes. The most famous lake is Loch Ness. Is there a monster in it? Nobody knows, but people still look.

Third, Sweden. Stockholm is a city on fourteen islands, so there is water everywhere. Sweden has almost one hundred thousand lakes, and in summer people swim in them. In winter, a lot of visitors would like to go to the far north to see the northern lights. And everywhere you go, try a local dish: Swedish meatballs, or a cinnamon bun with coffee.
